content: Human-labeling session — def-in-depth:hard seed 1. Objective: Two staggered rush waves hit your Construction Yard mid-episode, one from each latitude (the base spawns NORTH at y=14 or SOUTH at y=26 by seed). You inherit a two-pillbox front line at your matched latitude plus $2400. Keep the yard alive and have the pillbox line fire on the attackers, within about 50 turns.
